attribute_is_internal_check.name: attribute_is_internal_check
attribute_is_internal_check.value: NOT "attribute"."is_internal" OR NOT ("attribute"."is_visible_on_storefront" OR "attribute"."is_filterable" OR "attribute"."is_searchable" OR "attribute"."is_comparable" OR "attribute"."is_sortable")

order_adjustment_source_check.name: order_adjustment_source_check
order_adjustment_source_check.value: "order_adjustment"."source" IS NULL OR char_length("order_adjustment"."source") BETWEEN 1 AND 64

order_item_image_url_check.name: order_item_image_url_check
order_item_image_url_check.value: "order_item"."image_url" IS NULL OR char_length("order_item"."image_url") BETWEEN 1 AND 2048

sales_order_contact_check.name: sales_order_contact_check
sales_order_contact_check.value: ("sales_order"."contact_erased_at" IS NULL AND "sales_order"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "sales_order"."phone" IS NOT NULL AND "sales_order"."first_name" IS NOT NULL AND "sales_order"."last_name" IS NOT NULL) OR ("sales_order"."contact_erased_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sales_order"."email" IS NULL AND "sales_order"."phone" IS NULL AND "sales_order"."first_name" IS NULL AND "sales_order"."last_name" IS NULL)

order_shipping_provider_service_check.name: order_shipping_provider_service_check
order_shipping_provider_service_check.value: "order_shipping"."provider_service" IS NULL OR ("order_shipping"."provider_code" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("order_shipping"."provider_service") BETWEEN 1 AND 64)

order_shipping_destination_check.name: order_shipping_destination_check
order_shipping_destination_check.value: ("order_shipping"."kind" = 'pickup_point' AND "order_shipping"."destination" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("order_shipping"."destination") = 'object') OR ("order_shipping"."kind" <> 'pickup_point' AND "order_shipping"."destination" IS NULL)

shipping_method_provider_service_check.name: shipping_method_provider_service_check
shipping_method_provider_service_check.value: "shipping_method"."provider_service" IS NULL OR ("shipping_method"."provider_code" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("shipping_method"."provider_service") BETWEEN 1 AND 64)

shipping_method_pricing_check.name: shipping_method_pricing_check
shipping_method_pricing_check.value: jsonb_typeof("shipping_method"."pricing") = 'object' AND ("shipping_method"."pricing" ->> 'type') IS NOT NULL AND ("shipping_method"."pricing" ->> 'type') IN ('flat', 'free_over', 'tiers', 'carrier_on_delivery')

shipping_method_country_codes_check.name: shipping_method_country_codes_check
shipping_method_country_codes_check.value: array_ndims("shipping_method"."country_codes") = 1 AND cardinality("shipping_method"."country_codes") BETWEEN 1 AND 250 AND array_position("shipping_method"."country_codes", NULL) IS NULL AND array_to_string("shipping_method"."country_codes", ',') ~ '^[A-Z]{2}(,[A-Z]{2})*$' AND char_length(array_to_string("shipping_method"."country_codes", ',')) = 3 * cardinality("shipping_method"."country_codes") - 1

customer_auth_token_expires_at_check.name: customer_auth_token_expires_at_check
customer_auth_token_expires_at_check.value: "customer_auth_token"."expires_at" > "customer_auth_token"."created_at" AND ("customer_auth_token"."purpose" <> 'password_reset' OR "customer_auth_token"."expires_at" <= "customer_auth_token"."created_at" + interval '60 minutes') AND ("customer_auth_token"."purpose" <> 'email_verification' OR "customer_auth_token"."expires_at" <= "customer_auth_token"."created_at" + interval '2880 minutes')

email_message_recipient_check.name: email_message_recipient_check
email_message_recipient_check.value: ("email_message"."recipient_kind" <> 'guest' OR "email_message"."customer_id" IS NULL) AND ("email_message"."recipient_kind" <> 'admin' OR ("email_message"."customer_id" IS NULL AND "email_message"."order_id" IS NULL)) AND ("email_message"."recipient_kind" = 'admin' OR "email_message"."admin_user_id" IS NULL)

email_message_sent_check.name: email_message_sent_check
email_message_sent_check.value: ("email_message"."status" = 'sent') = ("email_message"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("email_message"."status" = 'sent') = ("email_message"."provider_message_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("email_message"."status" <> 'sent' OR "email_message"."provider_code" IS NOT NULL)

email_message_last_error_check.name: email_message_last_error_check
email_message_last_error_check.value: "email_message"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'unknown') OR "email_message"."last_error_code" IS NOT NULL

payment_provider_payment_id_status_check.name: payment_provider_payment_id_status_check
payment_provider_payment_id_status_check.value: "payment"."status" NOT IN ('processing', 'succeeded', 'expired', 'invalidated') OR "payment"."provider_payment_id" IS NOT NULL

payment_awaiting_customer_check.name: payment_awaiting_customer_check
payment_awaiting_customer_check.value: "payment"."status" <> 'awaiting_customer' OR ("payment"."provider_payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment"."redirect_url" IS NOT NULL)

payment_next_check_at_check.name: payment_next_check_at_check
payment_next_check_at_check.value: "payment"."status" NOT IN ('creating', 'awaiting_customer', 'processing', 'create_unknown') OR "payment"."next_check_at" IS NOT NULL

payment_event_dedupe_key_check.name: payment_event_dedupe_key_check
payment_event_dedupe_key_check.value: "payment_event"."dedupe_key" IS NULL OR (char_length("payment_event"."dedupe_key") <= 200 AND "payment_event"."dedupe_key" ~ '^[a-z]+:[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$' AND split_part("payment_event"."dedupe_key", ':', 1) = "payment_event"."source")

payment_event_fact_check.name: payment_event_fact_check
payment_event_fact_check.value: "payment_event"."source" NOT IN ('webhook', 'poll') OR ("payment_event"."provider_status" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_event"."provider_modified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_event"."amount" IS NOT NULL)

payment_event_money_check.name: payment_event_money_check
payment_event_money_check.value: ("payment_event"."amount" IS NULL) = ("payment_event"."currency" IS NULL) AND ("payment_event"."final_amount" IS NULL OR "payment_event"."amount" IS NOT NULL)

payment_event_status_change_check.name: payment_event_status_change_check
payment_event_status_change_check.value: ("payment_event"."to_status" IS NULL OR "payment_event"."applied") AND ("payment_event"."from_status" IS NULL OR ("payment_event"."to_status" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_event"."from_status" <> "payment_event"."to_status"))

payment_refund_note_check.name: payment_refund_note_check
payment_refund_note_check.value: "payment_refund"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("payment_refund"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

payment_refund_automatic_check.name: payment_refund_automatic_check
payment_refund_automatic_check.value: "payment_refund"."reason" NOT IN ('late_payment', 'duplicate_payment') OR ("payment_refund"."actor_admin_id" IS NULL AND "payment_refund"."note" IS NULL AND "payment_refund"."idempotency_key" IS NULL)

privacy_request_subject_email_check.name: privacy_request_subject_email_check
privacy_request_subject_email_check.value: "privacy_request"."subject_kind" <> 'email' OR "privacy_request"."subject_email_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "privacy_request"."status" IN ('completed', 'rejected')

privacy_request_note_check.name: privacy_request_note_check
privacy_request_note_check.value: "privacy_request"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("privacy_request"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500
